bullets.content: [general] After EVERY solve read top-6 hotspots (nearest face, local h vs requested) and call view(kind=error) before the next mesh call. Never skip it or leave a solve unused. If lag >1.3x, next one-factor test is a smaller size on that box.

[general] Write a 4-solve plan up front: S1 variant, S2 second factor, S3 DOF saver, S4 best combination. Never spend S1 on a stored recipe (quote its stored nodes/energy as baseline). Use all 4 solves; compare() final candidates before submit.
[general] One factor per solve: before each mesh call list differences from the previous call; if more than one, split. Multi-factor changes made energy changes unattributable.
[general] Never call compare(a,a): it returns noise (0.5%) and wastes a step (repeated violation). Compare the new solve with the previous one differing by exactly one factor.

[general] After every mesh call/solve compare delivered h near groups and hotspots with the request. If >1.15-1.2x requested (f2 0.0040 vs 0.003), shrink the requested size (e.g. 0.0034->0.0030) rather than adding edges.
[general] Add boxes at 0.002-0.003 over the exact error-hotspot band rather than lowering global h; this gave unusually good accuracy per DOF.
[general] Use mesh-only scans to choose h; do not spend a solve on a bracket worth <0.5% energy. Spend it on a structural test (wider box, different layout).
[general] Setup (f2 fixed, f23 4e6, f16 2.1e6, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3) verified repeatedly. Reuse verbatim.
[general] Below target score ∝ (1/e²)/DOFs (e²≈missing energy). At e≈16.5%, +1% DOFs needs ~+0.03% strain energy to break even. Submit the cheaper mesh when compare differs <5%.
[general] Choose submission by energy gain vs relative DOF increase (must exceed ~half the DOF increase below target), never by distance to a guessed or remembered reference energy.
[general] Box refinements on thin walls deliver ~1.2-1.3x requested size (0.0035 gave 0.0041-0.0048). Request 0.75-0.8x wanted local h and verify with hotspot local h.
[general] Check-point error (7.4%) is well below field error (18.6%). Optimise field energy norm; ignore single points.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Older control (h 0.007, 16983 DOFs, field 8.91%) is superseded by the a6 recipe (h 0.0078, 5878 nodes, SE 2.13391e-4, 8.38%); fallback only.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Variant S1: a6 recipe (h 0.0078, wall 0.0035, edge 22 0.0025 r0.006, pocket 0.003, f5/f7 sub-boxes 0.0016) with ONLY root box [0.016,-0.014,-0.0081,0.03,0.012,-0.004] 0.0025→0.0021. Baseline 5878 nodes, SE 2.13391e-4. Don't re-solve baseline.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Why root size: a6 hotspots #2 (f7 y+0.0085, 9.8%, h 0.0029), #3 (f7 y-0.0083, 9.3%), #4 (f5 y+0.008, 6.1%, h 0.0033) lie outside sub-boxes, inside the root box. Only root size reaches them. Target local h ≤0.0026.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Break-even: accept variant only if dSE% ≥0.03×dN% vs 2.13391e-4. 6400 nodes (+8.9%) needs SE ≥~2.1396e-4. If nodes >6500 or quality.min <0.105, try root 0.0022.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Spend all 4 solves, one structural experiment each: S1 root 0.0021; S2 root 0.0023; S3 winner + wall box 0.0035→0.004; S4 winner + pocket xmin 0.0125. view error after each; compare(best, runner-up) before submit.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Without f5/f7 sub-boxes the root box must be ≤0.0022. Root 0.0025 with edges 18/22 at 0.0017 r0.002 left arc hotspots at h 0.0030-0.0032 (41% of error in top 3), 9.05% vs 8.3-8.4% for sub-box recipes.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Extra box must be ≥1.5x finer than surroundings. f7 arc box 0.002 inside root 0.0025 gave only +0.075% SE for +3% DOFs. If retried use 0.0016 over y -0.0145..0.009 (a5's extended f7 sub-box).

[abc_00000065_bc0] Mesher branch jumps: h 0.011 gave 6429 nodes, 0.0085 gave 7076 vs 5490 at 0.0074; pocket 0.0036 gave 7325; edges 14/7 gave 7216. Free-mesh every candidate; reject those off the ~5500-6000 node branch. Don't raise h to save DOFs.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Edges lag ~1.76x: edges 22/18 at 0.0017 r0.002 delivered 0.0030 at root hotspots (radius too short); edge 22 at 0.0014 adds +121 nodes for little. Prefer boxes ≥1.5x finer; or edge 0.002 r0.004, or drop edges for a root box 0.0022 over z [-0.0081,-0.003].

[abc_00000065_bc0] SE ranks field error: 2.13129e-4→9.05%, 2.13391e-4→8.38%, 2.13519e-4→8.30%. Choose by SE gain per DOF; compare diffs <5% are ties, submit cheaper. Calibration: true error ≈1.8× compare diff when <5%.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Highlight a5: extending f7 sub-box to y -0.0145 at 0.0014 gave best SE (2.13519e-4) for +74 nodes. Arc ENDS pay; root-size test attacks them with a different lever.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Edge 18 (f5∩f12 root; confirm tag) at 0.0022 r0.004 was an older tweak (~+450 DOFs); edges lag here, prefer root box.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Box in a 1 mm slab misses its target (asked 0.0022, got 0.0028 at z≈-0.0072). Top hotspots (~50-54% of error) sit near f5, f7, f12, f4.
[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Do not raise h above 0.007 to save DOFs: the same refinements at h 0.010 gave 5922 nodes vs 5661 at h 0.007.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Check-point error (8.33%) is below field (9.05%) but close. Don't refine low-stress f52/f13 strip (y≈-0.037) or cell (0.0152,0.0274) unless check error binds.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Worst hidden check point near f12/f13 (0.015,-0.0375,-0.006), 16% error, h ~0.0046. If field error drops below 8%, add small box there to 0.003.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Recipe family plateaued (9.05% at 16785 DOFs vs 8.91% at 16983); tweaks of 0.0005 are useless. Need structural change.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Report solve-1 field error vs previous as noise; skip a solve for a variant with compare diff <5%.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Calibration: compare(2,3)=4.96% but true field error was 8.91% (~1.8x). When a diff is under 5%, treat true error ≈ 1.8 × diff to judge whether more DOFs pay.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Setup verified, equilibrium fine; reuse verbatim: 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, fixed f12, pressure 2.1e6 on f7.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] Do not spend solves on 10-20% more DOFs for +0.5% energy, or on one tiny factor (e.g. edge 40 size). Make the experiment structural (box layout, h pairing).

[abc_00000003_bc7] Older control (h 0.005, 24201 DOFs, 16.7%, 0.033717 J; f2 0.003, edges 40/39/8, box 0.0033) is superseded by the a2 variant base (h 0.0095, 16.3%, 0.033756 J); use only as fallback.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Variant base = a2 g5 recipe: h 0.0095; junction 0.0034; upper 0.0048; lower 0.0046; f2 0.0033 r0.005; edges 8/39 0.0026. Stored: 8125 nodes, 0.033756 J, 16.3%. Don't re-solve; a2 is control. S1: junction 0.0030, edges 0.0022; accept if energy gain % >= 0.5x node increase %.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Free-mesh S1 first. If nodes >9300 (~28k DOFs), scan junction 0.0031 by mesh() only. Target junction-band touching h <=0.0035; if delivered stays >=0.0038, go to 0.0028, not a wider box.
[abc_00000003_bc7] S2 (on better of base/S1): f2 0.0033->0.0025 r0.005 (f2 touching h 0.0042-0.0046; clamp ring holds 17-20% of error). Expect +3-5% nodes; keep only if energy rises >=0.15%.
[abc_00000003_bc7] S3 DOF saver: upper box 0.0048->0.0054 (upper barrel z 0.036-0.052 has no top hotspot). Expect -5-8% nodes; keep if energy loss <0.1%.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 39/8 earn their DOFs (dropping 40/39/8 cost -0.36% energy for -5.3% DOFs, score x0.94; adding 8/39 at 0.0026 gave +0.27% for +4.9%). Keep 39/8 in every recipe; this supersedes earlier 'drop edges' notes.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Edge 40 refinement is dead (0.002 r0.003: +2.75% nodes, -0.002% energy; 0.0028: +0.11%). Never add it; attack the clamp ring via f2 size or upper box.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Lower barrel z≈0.005 is most contested (5% spread; no lower box read 11% below consensus). Every recipe keeps lower box [-0.022,-0.017,0,0.022,0.017,0.021] at <=0.0046.
